notes.subject: togbɛ a babaw la
notes.rationale: כשכב עם אבתיו 'to lie with his fathers' ye suma-kuma ye min kɔrɔ ye 'ka sa'; Bambara y'a to a cogo la.

notes.subject: jurumutɔrw
notes.rationale: חטאים: 'sinners' (KJV) walima 'offenders/criminals' — Batseba ka kuma David fɛ ko a ni Shelomo na juguya ye ni Adoniyahu tun masa.

notes.subject: n'ce masakɛ
notes.rationale: Batseba ka kuma David masakɛ fɛ a yɛrɛ ma, jɔyɔrɔ dɔgɔya.

notes.subject: Shelomo
notes.rationale: Shelomo tɔgɔ bɔyɔrɔ ye shalom (hɛrɛ) ye — a bɛ jira fɔlɔ yɔrɔ nin ni (Solomɔ) ye.

translation: O kɔ, ni n'ce masakɛ bɛna togbɛ a babaw la, anw ne ni n'denkɛ Shelomo (Solomɔ) na kɛ jurumutɔrw ye.
